title: Laser-Plasma Accelerator Beams in Light Sources: Femtosecond High-Brightness Radiation through Chirped Pulse Injection
abstract: We propose a chirped-pulse injection scheme into a hard x-ray low-emittance synchrotron light source such as PETRA IV from a laser-plasma electron injector with active energy compression. The scheme enables delivering kA-scale short pulses with several tens of hertz repetition rate to any synchrotron beamline in the ring and allows producing femtosecond temporally coherent radiation pulses at target beamlines.
